description: Ask a database questions without holding its password. Run one SQL statement on a MySQL, PostgreSQL or ClickHouse database. The database enforces read mode; separate accounts enforce the write and admin tiers. In single-account mode both use DB_USER. Start with query and a SELECT.
author: Serg Parf

query.help: Get rows back, or the affected row count, from one SQL statement using the configured database account.
query.returns: columns and rows, or the affected row count

port.help: Database port; the engine's usual one when absent

socket.help: Unix socket path (MySQL and PostgreSQL) instead of host
